ProgramUnit.Name: QUERY_DRIVES_BLOCK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE query_drives_block IS
q_str varchar2(500);
BEGIN
 if :ctrl_block.l_drive_type is null then
 go_item('ctrl_block.l_drive_type');
 show_error('11105');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if :ctrl_block.l_drive_type = 'DNP' then /* drive sheet not printed */
 q_str := ' drive_sheet_date is null and chapter_id= :global.chapter_id ';
 end if;
 if :ctrl_block.l_drive_type = 'DMNP' then /* drives modified not printed */
 q_str := ' last_modified_date > drive_sheet_date and
 drive_sheet_date is not null and chapter_id= :global.chapter_id ';
 end if;
 if :ctrl_block.l_drive_type = 'DMAP' then /* drives modified and printed */
 q_str := 'last_modified_date <= drive_sheet_date and chapter_id= :global.chapter_id ';
 end if;
 if :ctrl_block.from_date is not null and
 :ctrl_block.to_date is not null then 
 q_str := q_str||' and drive_date between :ctrl_block.from_date and :ctrl_block.to_date and chapter_id= :global.chapter_id ';
 end if; 
 if :ctrl_block.from_date is null and
 :ctrl_block.to_date is not null then 
 q_str := q_str||' and drive_date <= :ctrl_block.to_date and chapter_id= :global.chapter_id ';
 end if; 
 if :ctrl_block.from_date is not null and
 :ctrl_block.to_date is null then 
 q_str := q_str||' and drive_date >= :ctrl_block.from_date and chapter_id= :global.chapter_id ';
 end if; 

 set_block_property('drives',DEFAULT_WHERE,q_str);
 go_block('drives');
 execute_query;
 set_block_property('drives',DEFAULT_WHERE,' ');
 set_block_property('drives',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_block_property('drives',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_CONTROL_BLOCK_ITEMS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE set_control_block_items(action IN varchar2) IS
BEGIN
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK.FROM_DATE' then
 item_change('ctrl_block.from_date',action);
 end if;
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK.TO_DATE' then
 item_change('ctrl_block.to_date',action);
 end if;
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK.L_DRIVE_TYPE' then
 item_change('ctrl_block.l_drive_type',action);
 end if;

 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve',action);

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_FROM_TO_DATE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_from_to_date(f_date IN date, t_date IN date) IS
 
BEGIN
 if f_date is not null and
 t_date is not null then
 if f_date > t_date then
 show_error('9192');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;

 
END;
